crossRefs.note: Rehoboam lived in Jerusalem, and built cities for defense in Judah.
Now in the fourteenth year of king Hezekiah, Sennacherib king of Assyria attacked all of the fortified cities of Judah…
“Go up on her walls, and destroy; but don’t make a full end. Take away her branches, for they are not Yahweh’s.
The king of Assyria sent Tartan and Rabsaris and Rabshakeh from Lachish to king Hezekiah with a great army to…
It will sweep onward into Judah. It will overflow and pass through. It will reach even to the neck. The stretching out…
shall I not, as I have done to Samaria and her idols, so do to Jerusalem and her idols?

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: He took the fortified cities which belonged to Judah, and came to Jerusalem.
translations.bsb: He captured the fortified cities of Judah and came as far as Jerusalem.
translations.kjv: And he took the fenced cities which pertained to Judah, and came to Jerusalem.
translations.asv: And he took the fortified cities which pertained to Judah, and came unto Jerusalem.
